source_note: 纯素读，仅读 text/ch01_one.txt，未开 md。字符区间为该文件 0 基字符偏移 [start, end)。

events.who: 我（叙事者，骑一辆红色轻便摩托车 red moped）
events.did: 猛捏生锈刹车（slammed on the rusty brakes）把 red moped 停下；轮胎在滚烫、近乎熔化的沥青上打滑，烧焦橡胶的气味刺鼻。
events.quote_head: I slammed on the rusty brakes
events.quote_anchor: I slammed on the rusty brakes, bringing my red moped to a stop.

events.who: 一匹油亮的黑马（glistening black horse）
events.did: 站在马路正中央——一侧是旗子在风中褪色的二手车行（used car dealership），另一侧是招牌已拆的前弹珠房（former pachinko parlor）。
events.quote_head: In the middle of the road
events.quote_anchor: a used car dealership with a fading flag fluttering in the wind and a former pachinko parlor with its signs taken down

events.did: 在小汽车、大卡车、公共汽车与摩托车的一片鸣笛声中安然立于路中央、缓缓转头；身量高约叙事者两倍（about twice my height）。
events.quote_head: Small cars, large trucks, buses, and
events.quote_anchor: Towering about twice my height, it stood in the center of the commotion, calmly moving its head around.

events.did: 我推上滑落的头盔檐后与马四目相对；马一双悲伤而莫名熟悉的黑眼睛（the horse’s eyes）紧盯着我。为确认自己没疯，我咧了咧嘴角。
events.quote_head: The brim of my helmet had slipped
events.quote_anchor: A sorrowful and somehow familiar black, the horse’s eyes were fixed on me.

events.did: 朝我走了两三步（took two, three steps toward me）；我脉搏加速、心跳如擂，马蹄敲击沥青的声音与我的心跳同频。
events.quote_head: The horse took two, three steps
events.quote_anchor: The sound of the horse’s hard hooves hitting the asphalt synced with the beating of my heart.

events.who: 四名穿同款尼龙夹克的男人（four men，马的控制者）
events.did: 凭空出现、围住那匹马；马鼻孔重重喷气、高高扬起前腿左右腾踏如舞，缰绳被拴牢（reins were secured）后立即安静下来。
events.quote_head: Four men wearing matching nylon jackets
events.quote_anchor: Four men wearing matching nylon jackets appeared out of nowhere and surrounded the horse.

events.did: 朝重新开动的周围车辆歉意鞠躬，把马牵往交通灯旁停着的拖车；马毫无抵抗地上坡、穿双门进栏厩（与先前判若两马），拖车以迟缓速度驶离。
events.quote_head: The men in the nylon jackets bowed
events.quote_anchor: The horse walked up the ramp and into the stall through a set of double doors without any resistance

events.who: 我（叙事者）与远去的拖车
events.did: 拖车在与自动消费贷款申请机（automated consumer loan-application machine）和浅蓝招牌便利店相临的路口左转；我在远去的车身上读到 “Mugikura Riding Club” 字样——马匹/拖车属于 Mugikura Riding Club（骑马俱乐部）。
events.quote_head: It turned left at the intersection
events.quote_anchor: On the body of the trailer vanishing into the distance, I caught the words “Mugikura Riding Club.”

events.did: 从拖车篷布与栏厩之间的缝隙探出头来（poked its head out），那双仿佛能把我吸进去的黑眼睛再次转向我。
events.quote_head: My eyes were glued to the faded
events.quote_anchor: My eyes were glued to the faded writing when the horse poked its head out from a gap between the trailer’s tarp and stall.

events.did: 我心中冒出 “Found you.”（找到你了）的念头；就在这念头出现前的一瞬，我感到马也正对我说着同一句话。
events.quote_head: Found you. A split second before I had
events.quote_anchor: A split second before I had the thought, I felt the horse saying the same thing to me.
